theTwoDefectsThisLanesOwnFalsifiersCaugh.one: THE FIRST FIX WAS THE NARROWER VERSION OF THE SAME DEFECT, AND ITS OWN DRY RUN MEASURED IT OUT. The first arm moved the keys the pair REACHED back into the fact build and left the rest excluded. Read-only full-county dry run (staging, this lane's own heavy-scan lease), line verbatim from the run's own log: `account-keyed exclusion vs served keyspace "the county's numeric served node keys (the parcel index's own numbering)" for 48491: 37334 of 319480 served key(s) excluded`. Those 37,334 are keys of the numerics keyspace that no published identifier reaches, and every one of them P-327 measured present on the declared 2026 roll -- so the arm was about to write 37,334 false retirements. `accountKeyedBlastRadius` is SET EQUALITY against a whole served keyspace (`hit === servedKeys.size`): 37,334 is not 319,480, so the guard could not fire and the run PROCEEDED past it into the crosswalk lines. The rejection is not a preference: the arm contradicted CP1's own answer to what 48491 should serve ('nothing in that keyspace is retired on a comparison between two numbering systems'), so the lane's answer to its own CP1 question falsified its own fix. What shipped instead: the third verdict is a DECLARATION -- kept in the fact build, not retired -- so the exclusion is empty and there is no write for the guard to be unable to see.
theTwoDefectsThisLanesOwnFalsifiersCaugh.two: THE GUARD WAS UNREACHABLE AT EXACTLY THE SCALE IT EXISTS FOR. `excludedWork.push(...excluded)` and `work.push(...kept)` are ARGUMENT LISTS; at full-county scale they exceed the engine's argument-count limit and the bake dies before the guard is consulted. Both directions measured on the base commit, same county, same store, same lease: the base as compiled dies with `Maximum call stack size exceeded` (P:/tmp/p370/dryrun-48491-base2.log) and the refusal this lane was sent to reproduce was only reachable after the two appends were made per-item loops -- base plus ONLY those two loops prints `319480 of 319480 served key(s) excluded` and refuses (P:/tmp/p370/dryrun-48491-base-spread.log). A guard that the defect's own population kills before it runs is not a control; that is why the append fix travels with this PR rather than after it.
theTwoDefectsThisLanesOwnFalsifiersCaugh.theConsequenceForHowThisWasThenBuilt: Both defects were found by running the lane's own pre-registered falsifiers against its own work rather than by review, and both were caught before any artifact was filed as done: F1 (the per-keyspace count beside the prediction) caught the first, and F3/F6 (the guard proven able to fire, from the run's own output) caught the second.

theDeclarationNeedsTwoFactsAndBothAreMea.theRule: A key is DECLARED (kept, not retired) only when BOTH hold: (1) the county publishes a pair over this run's account-shaped keys -- `PublishedPairMembership` present, which the CLI passes only when the extract read returned rows for keys in this run's work list; and (2) the parcel table does not use THIS key's shape at all -- `parcelTableShapeClasses`, the shape classes measured on `txgio_prop_ids` this run just read.
theDeclarationNeedsTwoFactsAndBothAreMea.whyNeitherAlone: The pair alone: the staged extracts (`tx_wcad_owner` / `tx_wcad_ag_valuation`) carry no county column, so a numeric account in one county can match a parcel in another; with the pair alone a cross-county pair row would turn HAYS -- whose parcel table does speak its keys' numbering -- into a county that declares its whole hollow set instead of retiring it, and the 56,629 measured hollow keys would silently stop being retired. The shape alone: a county with a disjoint numbering would stop retiring anything, with no published identifier taking the retirement's place -- a silent gap rather than a declared one.
theDeclarationNeedsTwoFactsAndBothAreMea.theFailureEachGuardsIsInTheSuites: `THE DECLARATION NEEDS BOTH FACTS: a pair present, and a parcel table that does not use this key's shape` and `HAYS' GOLDEN HOLLOW LIST IS UNCHANGED KEY FOR KEY -- refused, not declared, because Hays' table uses its keys' numbering` (the latter with the cross-county collision run through the fixed code: the list does not move by one key).

theGuardIsNotWeakenedAndWhatItStillCanno.unchanged: `accountKeyedBlastRadius` / `assertAccountKeyedBlastRadius` are NOT edited by this PR. The predicate is exact set equality (`servedKeys.size > 0 && hit === servedKeys.size`), and the refusal is a throw the CLI does not catch. The dry run of the fixed code fires it in three fixtures in the suites and, at full scale, on the base commit for the real county.
theGuardIsNotWeakenedAndWhatItStillCanno.theResidualThisLaneDoesNotClose: Set equality cannot see an exclusion that is 99% of a keyspace, and P-351's close already names that shape as P-320's row rather than this one's. What this lane does add beside it: the exclusion COUNT now rides the run's JSON summary, so a partial-but-vast exclusion is on the record even when the publish drops stdout (P-371). It is not a refusal and this close does not claim it is.

theThreeQuestionGate.whatTriggersIt: `joinGateBlocked && parcelTable` -- a gate-blocked county whose bake holds a parcel table. It runs INSIDE the bake, after promotion, over the work list the bake built. The SECOND arm additionally needs the county's published pair read to have returned rows for this run's account-shaped keys; with no rows (Hays) the pre-P-370 verdict is returned unchanged. The factory's pre-bake gate cannot see a single excluded node.
theThreeQuestionGate.whatFailsWhenALiveKeyspaceIsExcluded: Two different failures, both measured. Before P-351 the run WRITES: Williamson's 2026-09-17 publish retired all 282,570 published R nodes while 319,480 live numeric rows sat beside them, and the write reads as an earned absence with an authority -- a fact about the parcel rather than a failed lookup. Since P-351 the run REFUSES instead (reproduced above, 319,480 of 319,480: BAKE_FAILED, nothing written) -- which is the state this lane found the county in, unable to publish at all. This lane removes neither the refusal nor the guard; it removes the exclusion the refusal was firing on.
